notes: Mode shapes from ccx *FREQUENCY are normalised to unit generalised (consistent) mass; gm_lumped is the HRZ-lumped check.

Item point masses are translational (ccx MASS); their own rotary inertia is not represented; face-attached items hang on RBE3 CG nodes (no added stiffness).  The pintle needle, PD-02 crank housing and servo drive are rigid: the pintle/linkage period excludes the servo gear-train / link / needle-stem compliance (MISSING) and is therefore a LOWER bound on the true period.

Pc transducer: line 205 miniature seat-mounted unit, mass MISSING -> ASSUMED 26 g (solid-steel D12 x 30 envelope, bounding), RBE3 to the 1/8-27 NPT seat bore (thread / body compliance not modelled -> period LOWER bound).
Rigid airframe; the airframe's own modes are outside this model (ICD).  T_REF stiffness: the hot B1/A1 states lower E of 6061 by up to ~5-10 % at 120-150 C (f by ~2.5-5 %).
Residual = static response not represented by the computed modes = modes above f_max (T < T_min).
